# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/subscription

Unwatch a repo (unsubscribe from notifications)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-198`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Repo does not exist

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.Unwatch | controller | Call repo_model.WatchRepo with doWatch=false |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | repo_model.WatchRepo | repository | Get existing watch record; If mode is WatchModeAuto, set to WatchModeDont; Otherwise set to WatchModeNone (delete record) |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| When unwatching, if current mode is WatchModeAuto, transition to WatchModeDont instead of WatchModeNone | state_transition | !doWatch && watch.Mode == WatchModeAuto |
